g.text: Submission commits the frozen request before 202.
Accepted work never depends on browser/session lifetime.
No source reads, queue access or publication.
First action: os.setsid(), then private TMPDIR.
stop sends SIGTERM to the child and process group
child PID, SIGKILL both after two seconds, and reaps.
After every outcome: SIGKILL to group child PID
(missing group ignored), then remove the directory.
One global calculation; no broker, retries,
Same backend image as API/migration; database-only settings.
Dedicated health check, automatic restart, init and shutdown grace.
